title: Issues with shared resources indicator
body: ### Tested versions 4.6 ### System information W10 ### Issue description #109458 introduced a very nice feature, but the implementation is... rough xd There were various regression fixes after this PR, but there are still some usability and code problems. Usability: - [ ] If an external Resource has a sub-resource, the link says that the sub-resource is external to scene. It's not related to any scene, so the tooltip should be different. (this is Gradient inside GradientTexture2D resource saved to a file) - [x] If the Resource is additionally built-in (after you click the link icon), there is a missing space, due to how the message is constructed. It only appears if the parent resource is inspected inside a node. - [ ] The above is a result of the fact that the original PR completely ignored external Resources and Resource occurrences are only counted inside nodes. When an external resource is inspected, its sub-resources should probably be counted properly and display correct status. - [ ] Additionally, if you hover the Make Unique option, it sounds off, like half of it was missing. Duplicate what? Code: - [ ] Minor, but this variable is not used consistently: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/5002677a4db268d7c4c3f317b175eefd9bdd6e4a/editor/inspector/editor_resource_picker.cpp#L1410 - [ ] This method is called `_has_parent_resource()`, but returns the resource... https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/5002677a4db268d7c4c3f317b175eefd9bdd6e4a/editor/inspector/editor_resource_picker.h#L124 ### Steps to reproduce No particular steps. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
